title: 490. Battleships in a Board

examples.explanation: One lone X plus one vertical ship of length 3 make two battleships.
No X cells means no ships.
A single X is one ship.

hints: Ships are straight lines with at least one empty cell gap, never touching side by side.
Count only the top-left cell of each ship: an X with no X above and no X to the left.
This single pass needs O(1) extra memory.
